description: The complete Italy income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: IRPEF 23/33/43% (2026) with every work, family and expense credit, the €75,000 cap and the €120,000/€200,000 cuts; Cuneo fiscale: tax-free sum and extra credit; trattamento integrativo; Regional surtax for every region and municipal surtax for the 21 regional capitals (others by rate); INPS employee contributions incl. the extra 1%; Gestione separata for freelancers; Regime forfettario 5%/15% vs ordinary self-employment; Rentals: cedolare secca 21%/10%/26% vs ordinary IRPEF; Interest, dividends, capital gains and losses at 26%/12.5%, crypto at 33%; Impatriati regime 50%/60%; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in EUR; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.
